title: Have a Problem & Have a Question
partTitle: Have a Problem & Have a Question
situation: Reporting a machine problem during a shift.
objective: Use have a problem and have a question to ask for help at work.

dialogue.speaker: Narrator
dialogue.english: Sometimes I have a problem with the conveyor during my shift.
dialogue.indonesian: Terkadang saya punya masalah dengan konveyor selama shift saya.

dialogue.speaker: Narrator
dialogue.english: When I have a problem, I tell my supervisor right away.
dialogue.indonesian: Ketika saya punya masalah, saya langsung memberi tahu supervisor saya.

dialogue.speaker: Narrator
dialogue.english: If I have a question about the machine, I ask the senior technician.
dialogue.indonesian: Jika saya punya pertanyaan tentang mesin, saya bertanya kepada teknisi senior.

dialogue.speaker: Narrator
dialogue.english: Before I do the repair, I have a question about the spare part.
dialogue.indonesian: Sebelum melakukan perbaikan, saya punya pertanyaan tentang suku cadang.

dialogue.speaker: Narrator
dialogue.english: My supervisor says, "If you have a question, please ask me."
dialogue.indonesian: Supervisor saya berkata, "Kalau kamu punya pertanyaan, silakan tanya saya."

keyExpressions.english: have a problem with the machine

learningNotes: problem dan question adalah benda yang bisa dihitung, jadi memakai a.
Gunakan have a problem with + benda: have a problem with the conveyor.
Untuk bertanya dengan sopan, kamu bisa bilang: Can I ask a question?
